services.title: Asphalt & Architectural Shingle Roofing
services.short_description: Owens Corning Duration Series shingles with SureNail Technology, installed by a certified crew.
services.long_description: NEPA Roofing Pros installs Owens Corning Duration Series shingles. With the patented SureNail Technology, strength and durability are built into every Duration Series shingle. We come prepared with certifications and training, ensuring your roof is installed the right way, the first time.

services.title: Metal Roofing
services.short_description: Standing seam, shingle-look, and rib panel metal systems for residential, agricultural, and light commercial.
services.long_description: Time for a new roof? You've reached the right place for metal roofing. Panel-Loc Plus gives residential, agricultural, and light commercial projects superior durability with an attractive appearance. Our CF Shingle has been specifically designed for shingle style with Concealed Fastening technology.

services.title: Commercial Roofing
services.short_description: Flat and low-slope commercial roofing systems installed with minimal disruption to your operation.
services.long_description: At NEPA Roofing Pros, we specialize in dependable commercial roofing solutions designed to protect your business, your property, and your long term investment. From blacktop roofing to a range of commercial roofing systems, our experienced team delivers quality workmanship with a focus on durability, performance, and reliability. We understand that commercial roofing projects require careful planning and efficient execution, which is why we work closely with property owners and managers to minimize disruption while ensuring every roof is installed or serviced to the highest standards.

services.title: Roof Repair & Leak Repair
services.short_description: Emergency and scheduled repairs for leaks, storm damage, and failing low-slope roofs.
services.long_description: We can provide expert and emergency roof installation and repair service. Where a repair is the right answer we say so. We handle leaks, flashing failures, storm damage, and low-slope EPDM problems, pull the permits the job needs, and advise on the right materials before any work starts.
services._evidence: Homepage: 'We can provide expert and emergency roof installation service.' Google review republished on the homepage (Teresa Thomas) describes a severe water leak on a low-pitch roof requiring EPDM, permits obtained by the company. A second review references 'roof replacement or repair'.

services.title: Gutter Installation
services.short_description: Seamless gutters backed by a 5-year workmanship warranty.
services.long_description: 5 year workmanship warranty! At NEPA Roofing Pros we pride ourselves on providing high-quality gutter installation, sized and pitched to move the water your roof sheds away from the house rather than down the wall behind it.

services_not_carried_forward: The client's site splits Asphalt Shingle and Architectural Shingle into two near-identical pages (both are Owens Corning Duration Series) — merged into one service.

Standing Seam, Shingle Look Metal, Rib Panel, Stone Coated, SL-16, PBR Panel, Imperial Rib, Lok Seam, Classic Rib are nine separate pages for what is one service with product variants — merged into Metal Roofing sub_services.

Sister brands (NEPA Construction Pros, NEPA Painting Pros, NEPA Landscaping Pros, NEPA Cleaning Pros) and the 'Our Network' partner roofers (Stott, Royal, READCORP) are other companies, not services of this one.

testimonials.name: Don Biggs
testimonials.text: Great work. Fast and reasonable. Nice job cleaning up. Extremely Satisfied

testimonials.name: Gary Brower
testimonials.text: Did great work did everything they said done in one day cleaned up was like they weren't even there Byron and Jame were great to work with

testimonials.name: Teresa Thomas
testimonials.text: We reached out to multiple companies, including NEPA Roofing Pros, for a severe water leak issue on our low-pitch roof that required EPDM roofing. Bryan from NEPA Roofing Pros stood out by being prompt in responding to our calls and questions. He provided valuable advice on the right materials to use and ensured all necessary permits were obtained. The team arrived well-prepared and completed the work within the agreed time frame. After the job was done, Bryan came by to ensure we were satisfied with the results. He truly simplified the roof replacement process for me. If you're looking for a reliable team for roof replacement or repair, I highly recommend NEPA Roofing Pros.

testimonials.name: Stephanie Ward
testimonials.text: Excellent communication and service from the start. Extremely easy and flexible to work with. Reasonable price and excellent workmanship. We are very happy with our roof! Thanks NEPA Roofing Pros

testimonials.name: Paul Kerrigan
testimonials.text: All of my inquiries and questions were answered promptly before, during, and after the job was completed by NEPA Roofing Pros. The replacement roof project was completed in a timely manner, the workmen were professional, the site, with the exception of a new roof, looked the same after work was completed as it did before the project commenced, and the price was very reasonable.

testimonials.name: John Ferry
testimonials.text: NEPA Roofing is awesome. Byron is very upfront on his pricing and provides a detailed estimate and invoice. Work is top quality.

testimonials.name: Bryan Ruda
testimonials.text: We highly recommend Byron, Bobby and the crew at NEPA Roofing Pros. They are highly skilled and great with communication. They respect your time and get the job scheduled and completed quickly. Our roof looks great and it is finally watertight!

_notes.blocked_reason: Every URL other than the homepage returns HTTP 403 to curl/Firecrawl and renders the site's own 404 page in a real browser, redirecting back to the root. The client's site is effectively a one-page site right now: every nav link and all ~100 city landing pages in its sitemap are dead. Content was therefore taken from the homepage only.
_notes.security_finding: The homepage contains an injected hidden spam link (a position:absolute; left:-10909px div linking to califarmacia.com) inside the 'Home' nav item. Combined with the site-wide 403/404 failure this is consistent with a compromised WordPress install. The injected markup was NOT carried into the generated site. Worth flagging to the client.
